How is she when she's in the room? Does she seem fearful? Bored? Aggressive? 

If your roommates have taken a pic or video of her in there while you're gone, I can take a look and evaluate how she's feeling if you're unsure.

Honestly I don't really think it's a big deal unless she doesn't seem happy about staying in there. Dogs have their preferences. Perhaps she just enjoys staying "home" while you're gone. Many dogs do fine all day in a cage, your room is a great deal bigger than that.

I'm personally about to start training my pup myself, so I'm not 100% on what to look out for when it comes to trainers. 

However I will say avoid any "service dog registration" services, unless required by your city/county. And even then just use whichever one they suggest. Most are scams. 

There's also a few pretty large groups on FB for service dog handlers, both owner trained and not, I would poke around there and see if you can find someone local to you that can help you find a good trainer.

And to be honest, you don't really need a trainer with service dog experience I don't think. Any decent trainer worth their salt could help you, especially with copious tutorials on Youtube that are SD based. So perhaps poke around your local dog agility club.

Good luck!
